backToProfile: Back to “How you want to found”
title: How do you want to build this venture?
intro: 19 short questions about how you want to build this specific venture. The point is to make expectations visible – not to answer right or wrong.

points.noRight: There are no right or wrong answers.
points.thisVenture: Your answers apply to this venture and this period.
points.privateFirst: After you submit, your answers are only for you at first. You share them with the team later, explicitly.
points.beta: This is a beta version: wording and evaluation may still change after testing.

takeover.title: Some of your earlier answers can be taken over as a starting point.
takeover.text: This applies to questions that were asked in exactly this way in the earlier version. You can review and change them. You confirm and submit the beta entirely anew yourself.
takeover.take: Take earlier answers over as a starting point

from.takeover: Some answers are here as a starting point from your earlier version. Review them and change what is different today.
from.previous: Your last submission is here as a starting point. Review it and change what is different today.

vision.title: Vision and priorities
vision.lead: Where should the venture go, and what matters to you?

ownership.title: Ownership and financing
ownership.lead: How do you think about a sale and external capital?

role.title: Role
role.lead: Which role do you imagine for yourself?

time.title: Time and commitment
time.lead: How much commitment is realistic, and what do you expect from others?

money.title: Money and risk
money.lead: When do you need income, and how much risk do you take on?

pace.title: Pace and quality
pace.lead: How fast should things go, and how finished should something be?

deciding.title: Deciding
deciding.lead: Who decides what – in everyday work and when you disagree?

communication.title: Communication
communication.lead: When do you want to hear about changes elsewhere?

flow.submitHint: When all questions are answered you can submit. “I haven't decided yet” is a valid answer.
flow.submitDoesNotShare: Submitting shares nothing: afterwards your answers are visible only to you at first.
flow.privateBadge: Only for you – never appears in the team comparison

errors.generic: That could not be submitted. Your answers are saved – please try again shortly.

result.title: Your summary
result.intro: This is how you said you want to build this venture – briefly summarised. It is a basis for conversation, not an assessment.
result.private: Visible to you – in the team comparison only if you share it.
result.updateHint: Your last submission stays valid until you submit and share a new version.
result.draftText: A new run is in progress. Your last submission stays valid until you submit the new one.
result.noAnswer: There is no answer for this.

share.title: Team comparison

explain.p1: Your shared run can only appear in the joint comparison once all current team members have also submitted and shared their run.
explain.p2: Until then nobody sees your answers in the team comparison.
explain.p3: You can withdraw the sharing at any time.
explain.p4: Sharing applies to this run only. If you answer again later, you decide again. Amount fields “only for you” never appear in the team comparison.

share.revokeConfirm: If you withdraw the sharing, the joint comparison may temporarily disappear for the team. Your own answers stay visible to you.
share.on: You have shared this run for the team comparison.
share.off: Sharing is withdrawn. Your run is private again.
share.missing: Some requirements for the joint comparison are still missing.
share.olderActive: An earlier version of yours is still shared for the team comparison. This newer version is only yours until you explicitly share it.

team.title: Venture Alignment (Beta)
team.text: Your joint comparison only appears once all current members have submitted and shared – until then nobody sees anything from the others.
team.not_started: You have not started the beta yet.
team.completed: You have submitted. Your run is visible only to you.

report.title: How you want to build this venture
report.intro: This is how all current members said they want to build this venture. Differences are conversation starters; agreement is not an assessment. All current members see the same report.
report.notReadyTitle: The joint comparison is not available right now
report.notReady: Some requirements for the joint comparison are still missing.
report.closing: The comparison only describes what you stated. It does not assess how well you fit together.
